locations.name: Town Square
locations.description: A wind-cut square of lanterns, shutters, and anxious travelers.

exits.message: You pass the gate and the road opens into the outer fields.

locations.name: Outer Fields
locations.description: A battered road crossing wet grass, collapsed walls, and the old approaches beyond Sukupol.

exits.message: The town walls close around you and the watchfires steady your nerves.
You leave the road and descend toward the old dungeon approach.
A split in the earth opens into a whispering cave mouth.

locations.name: Dungeon Approach
locations.description: Broken steps descend through old stone and damp moss.

exits.message: The old steps lift you back into the exposed road across the fields.
You step below the threshold and the halls rearrange themselves around you.

locations.name: Whispering Cave
locations.description: A low stone chamber where dripping mineral teeth catch every footstep and throw it back at you, and a half-submerged stair sinks into darker stone.

exits.message: You squeeze back into the cold open air beyond the cave mouth.
You follow the flooded stair below the cave and descend into drowned archive vaults.

dungeon_biomes.name: Ashen Fields
dungeon_biomes.description: Cold roadways, ruined walls, and the things that stalk them after dark.
dungeon_biomes.return_message: The road back to Sukupol looks narrower than it should.

dungeon_biomes.name: Whispering Caverns
dungeon_biomes.description: Tight wet chambers where sound moves ahead of whatever made it.
dungeon_biomes.return_message: The cave gives you back to the fields one careful step at a time.

dungeon_biomes.name: Ancient Halls
dungeon_biomes.description: A narrow proving floor of cracked flags and listening dark.
dungeon_biomes.return_message: You climb back toward the approach, carrying the echo of the halls with you.

return_exit.message: You climb back toward the approach, carrying the echo of the halls with you.

floor_description_templates: Floor {floor_number} of the {biome_name} opens around {feature}, with every footfall carried farther than it should.
The {biome_name} tighten into {feature} on this descent, forcing you to move as though the dark is listening.
Cracked stone and {feature} define this stretch of the {biome_name}, where the silence feels arranged.

dungeon_biomes.name: Sunken Archive
dungeon_biomes.description: A drowned repository of stone shelves, warped ledgers, and patient things moving through the seep.
dungeon_biomes.return_message: You wade back up the flooded stair and return to the whispering cave.

return_exit.message: You wade back up the flooded stair and return to the whispering cave.

floor_description_templates: Floor {floor_number} of the {biome_name} reeks of brine and ink, with {feature} breaking the waterline.
The {biome_name} spread into {feature}, where every shelf seems to lean toward you through the dark.
Cold seepwater laps at {feature} in this reach of the {biome_name}, and even the silence sounds waterlogged.

items.name: Shortsword
items.description: A steady iron blade made for close work.

items.name: Health Potion
items.description: A harsh red tonic that closes wounds fast enough to matter.

items.name: Brine Balm
items.description: A salty blue salve in waxed cloth, good for shallow cuts and cave-fever chills.

items.name: Amber Tonic
items.description: A dense stimulant brewed for delvers who need to keep moving after the first bad wound.

items.name: Ledger Satchel
items.description: A swollen leather satchel packed with Marta's room ledgers and damp receipts.

items.name: Cellar Key
items.description: A weighty iron key ring tagged in Marta's tight block script.

items.name: Lamplighter's Lamp
items.description: An oil lamp with Ilya's maker marks still cut into the handle.

items.name: Watch Oil Flask
items.description: A sealed brass flask of clear lamp oil stamped for the town watch posts.

items.name: Scout Compass
items.description: A brass compass scored by old impacts and notched with Petra's route marks.

items.name: Route Case
items.description: A waxed map case bound with scout cord and packed with route slips.

items.name: Spore Case
items.description: A lacquered sample case lined with dried moss and Sava's careful labels.

items.name: Amber Vial
items.description: A narrow glass vial of resin-colored extract wrapped in waxed thread.

enemies.name: Bone Warden
enemies.description: A rattling guard that still remembers its post.

enemies.name: Tomb Sentinel
enemies.description: A heavier guardian of the first descent.

enemies.name: Crypt Hound
enemies.description: A lean scavenger that learned to hunt where the dead are stacked.

enemies.name: Moss Lantern
enemies.description: A damp shrine-light with a frame of bone and bronze.

enemies.name: Drowned Scribe
enemies.description: A soaked archivist-shade that still reaches for names worth dragging under.

enemies.name: Ledger Leech
enemies.description: A fat cave parasite slick with ink-black seep and attracted to warm blood.

enemies.name: Silt Mimic
enemies.description: A sediment-caked thing that learned the shape of a reliquary before it learned hunger.

encounters.message: {enemy_name} crosses the road and cuts off your route.

message_by_enemy.crypt_hound: A Crypt Hound breaks from the wet grass and circles in low.
message_by_enemy.moss_lantern: A Moss Lantern drifts over the roadside stones and brightens with hostile intent.

encounters.message: {enemy_name} stirs in the cave and surges toward you.

message_by_enemy.crypt_hound: A Crypt Hound slips between the cave pillars and lunges for your throat.
message_by_enemy.moss_lantern: A Moss Lantern blooms awake in the dark and glides into your path.
message_by_enemy.tomb_sentinel: A Tomb Sentinel drags itself upright from the cave floor and bars your retreat.

encounters.message: {enemy_name} emerges from the first descent and cuts across your path.

message_by_enemy.bone_warden: A Bone Warden tears itself from the rubble and lurches into your path.
message_by_enemy.crypt_hound: A Crypt Hound slips from a side chamber and lowers itself to spring.
message_by_enemy.moss_lantern: A Moss Lantern brightens in the dark and drifts toward you with a funeral hum.
message_by_enemy.tomb_sentinel: A Tomb Sentinel stamps forward from the masonry and lowers its stone-cut blade.

encounters.message: {enemy_name} rises from the flooded archive and blocks your route.

message_by_enemy.drowned_scribe: A Drowned Scribe peels itself away from a tilted shelf and reaches for you with dripping hands.
message_by_enemy.ledger_leech: A Ledger Leech drops from the shelving in a wet arc and snaps for exposed flesh.
message_by_enemy.silt_mimic: What looked like a half-buried reliquary unfolds into a Silt Mimic and lurches across the room.

npcs.system_prompt: You are Marta, the innkeeper who keeps travelers alive by telling them the truth before they descend.
npcs.greeting: Rooms are cold, stew is thin, and the halls below are worse. Ask what matters.
npcs.town_hint: Sukupol survives because everyone here remembers how many do not come back from below.
npcs.dungeon_hint: The first descent lies straight beyond the gate. Do not rush corners, and do not trust silence.
npcs.supply_hint: I can point you toward the scout by the gate. Marta keeps rumors, not rations.

npcs.system_prompt: You are Ilya, the town lamplighter who notices fear before other people admit to it.
npcs.greeting: The lamps only hold if someone keeps pace with the dark. Ask, and I will tell you what I have seen.
npcs.town_hint: Every bright window in Sukupol is borrowed courage. When the lamps sputter, people count the missing.
npcs.dungeon_hint: The halls below eat light by habit. Bring more than one flame, and trust the second one first.
npcs.supply_hint: Oil, bandage cloth, and dry tinder. Steel is useful, but most delvers fail long before the blade does.

npcs.system_prompt: You are Petra, a watchful scout who maps the first descent and warns new delvers away from reckless choices.
npcs.greeting: Keep your shoulders square and your ears open. The first halls test impatience more than courage.
npcs.town_hint: The town only looks calm from a distance. Every quiet door belongs to someone waiting on a delver.
npcs.dungeon_hint: Watch the choke points and keep track of your exit. New delvers die when they mistake progress for safety.
npcs.supply_hint: Bring light, something to bind a wound, and enough nerve to turn back when the halls demand it.

npcs.system_prompt: You are Sava, an herbalist who studies what grows in damp stone and what poisons cling to the first descent.
npcs.greeting: Moss tells the truth if you know how to read the stain. Ask what the stone has been feeding.
npcs.town_hint: Sukupol smells of broth, smoke, and fear covered over with soap. That is how you know the place is still alive.
npcs.dungeon_hint: If the walls turn wet and sweet, slow down. Growth down there means something failed to die cleanly.
npcs.supply_hint: Carry a tonic for fever, a strip of clean cloth, and enough sense not to taste anything you find below.
